def: properly, to wrap; hence, to depart (i.e. turn about)

words.word: how long wilt thou go about

occurrences.text: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
words: How long wilt thou go about
